THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE DISTRIBUTED WITH BAZEL BUILD VISUALIZER

Bazel Build Visualizer redistributes the runtime components below in its
deploy jar. Artifact coordinates and versions are the exact Bazel-resolved
runtime closure shipped in //app:app_deploy.jar (the runtime closure of its
//app:app binary input). Test and benchmark-only artifacts are excluded.
The adjoining files preserve exact upstream license and notice texts under
collision-safe names; the fat jar's ambiguous generic META-INF legal entries
are not relied upon. APACHE-2.0.txt is the exact unmodified Apache License 2.0
text and is shared only by projects that publish that standard text unchanged.

MAVEN RUNTIME CLOSURE

  Artifact: io.airlift:aircompressor:2.0.3
  Project: https://github.com/airlift/aircompressor
  License: Apache License 2.0.
  Legal files: AIRCOMPRESSOR-APACHE-2.0.txt, AIRCOMPRESSOR-NOTICE.md

  Snappy-derived Java implementation
    Embedded source in Aircompressor 2.0.3; there is no separate runtime
    artifact or version. Project ancestry: https://github.com/google/snappy
    License: BSD-3-Clause.
    Copyright and license: AIRCOMPRESSOR-NOTICE.md

SHADED AND NATIVE COMPONENTS

gRPC Netty Shaded 1.83.1 packages these components under relocated names and
ships their native libraries in META-INF/native/:

  Netty 4.2.15.Final
    Shaded modules cover common, buffer, transport, resolver, codec, HTTP/2,
    proxy/SOCKS, handler and native epoll/unix support.
    Project: https://github.com/netty/netty
    License: Apache License 2.0.
    Legal files: GRPC-NETTY-SHADED-APACHE-2.0.txt,
      GRPC-NETTY-SHADED-NOTICE.txt

  Netty TCNative BoringSSL Static 2.0.75.Final
    TLS native libraries are shipped for Linux, macOS and Windows.
    Project: https://github.com/netty/netty-tcnative
    License: Apache License 2.0.
    Legal files: GRPC-NETTY-SHADED-APACHE-2.0.txt,
      GRPC-NETTY-SHADED-NOTICE.txt, TOMCAT-NATIVE-APACHE-2.0.txt,
      BORINGSSL-LICENSE.txt

  BoringSSL commit 0226f30467f540a3f62ef48d453f93927da199b6
    Statically linked by Netty TCNative 2.0.75.Final.
    Project: https://boringssl.googlesource.com/boringssl/
    License: Apache License 2.0 plus the support-code terms retained upstream.
    Legal file: BORINGSSL-LICENSE.txt

  Apache Tomcat Native fork
    Netty's upstream notice identifies a forked and modified Tomcat Native;
    it does not assign that embedded fork a separate artifact or version.
    Project: https://tomcat.apache.org/native-doc/
    License: Apache License 2.0.
    Legal files: GRPC-NETTY-SHADED-NOTICE.txt,
      TOMCAT-NATIVE-APACHE-2.0.txt

  The upstream Netty NOTICE also names Maven Wrapper build scripts. They are
  not a runtime component, but its referenced exact legal file is retained as
  MAVEN-WRAPPER-APACHE-2.0.txt so the unmodified NOTICE remains self-contained.

Pty4J 0.13.8 packages libpty and helper binaries for macOS, Linux, FreeBSD and
Windows under resources/com/pty4j/native/. Its upstream notice records its elt,
JPty and JNA ancestry. Windows payloads also contain:

  WinPTY (bundled with Pty4J 0.13.8; no separate version declared)
    Project: https://github.com/JetBrains/winpty
    License: MIT.
    License text: WINPTY-LICENSE.txt

  Windows Terminal 1.22.11141.0 (OpenConsole and ConPTY)
    Project: https://github.com/microsoft/terminal
    License: MIT.
    License and upstream third-party notice:
      WINDOWS-TERMINAL-LICENSE.txt, WINDOWS-TERMINAL-NOTICE.md

VENDORED RUNTIME SOURCES AND ASSETS

Bazel 9.2.0 protocol schemas
  Vendored source from: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/releases/tag/9.2.0
  License: Apache License 2.0, including Bazel's upstream license additions.
  License text: BAZEL-APACHE-2.0.txt
  Thirteen Bazel .proto source files and their generated Java classes are in
  the deploy jar.

googleapis protocol schemas
  Source reviewed at: c3e3d8a2031ec31f0f81fa42454ba55c7b40f284
  Project: https://github.com/googleapis/googleapis
  License: Apache License 2.0.
  License text: GOOGLEAPIS-APACHE-2.0.txt
  Eight Build Event Service and google/api .proto source files and their
  generated Java classes are in the deploy jar.

google/pprof profile schema
  Source reviewed at: ca85771921e4d23ebb56030bf1e488f215f26d36
  Project: https://github.com/google/pprof
  License: Apache License 2.0.
  License text: PPROF-APACHE-2.0.txt
  The vendored profile.proto defines the normalized wire format read from
  Bazel's --starlark_cpu_profile output.
